answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique paragliding license with flight log — a license with logged flights over three years — which makes the shale of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Fakes fail here because a license with logged flights over three years is tied to something outside the network; the ocean of the attack is that the farm must now operate in the physical world, where clones are slow and visible. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the terrace of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
